title: Chapter 373
content:
Chapter 373

The sky turned blood-colored, the endless gunpowder smoke on the ground was burning, and the innocent souls flying around were howling.

The entire Gaotianyuan, the original sacred belonging, the destination of the soul, has now become a hell.

"Unforgivable sinner, offended the honor of the gods of Gaotianyuan, desecrated the sacred land, today you will die."

Susanoo roared angrily, parried Zhong Yu's attack with the long sword in his hand, with a flash of brilliance, he continued to attack.

The endless brilliance flickered, and the dazzling golden light pierced people's eyes, which represented the incomparable activity of Susanoo's divine power, swaying and dispersing in the air, telling his anger.

Zhong Yu opened his hands, stretched his right hand forward towards Susanoo's footsteps, and endless noble purple energy spread, blocking his attack.

"The gods live in the underworld, so they shouldn't offend the human world. You intervene in the disputes of the human world without authorization and bring about today's disaster. It's just as it should be."

Shenhang stared at Susanoo, his face still expressionless, Zhong Yu said slowly.

"The despicable snatchers have usurped the power of my bloodline and the authority of the world. Foreign thieves have the face to say these things."

Hearing what he said just now, Susanoo became even more angry, the divine power in his body expanded outwards stronger, the thin purple energy was already unstoppable, trembling slightly.

"So what? An incompetent person is worthy of owning the world. To be captured by me, an outsider, shows your cowardice and weakness even more."

"Get out of the way now, otherwise, even in this Netherland, the kingdom of gods, I will cut you down by the sword."

There was a sneer, and I felt extremely contemptuous of Susanoo's anger, and even more amused at his rejection of outsiders.

Susanoo didn't speak, and raised the divine sword in his hand. The golden light gathered in it was dazzling, and the light was hotter than the sun, and the incomparable power gathered in it. When he stabbed forward, the terrifying attack had already killed him. come over.

'Stubborn! '

Cursing secretly in his heart, Zhong Yu didn't dare to neglect, the purple energy in his hand became more and more intense, turning into a light curtain, blocking Susanoo's attack.

After some actions just now, Zhong Yu's goal has been achieved.

More than 100,000 Japanese gods perished, no, or those monsters perished, their bodies and souls turned into strong luck, and quickly shrouded Zhong Yu.

Now, if someone can perform the secret technique and look at him, he will definitely be surprised to find that the luck above his head is boundless, condensed into a watery shape, and the extremely dazzling white luck covers the whole body, making the whole person a little hazy.

With so much luck, he was already overwhelmed.

It is indeed a god that the whole of Japan has long believed in. Even if the strength is very weak, each of them has absorbed hundreds of thousands of years of belief. After a long time, the accumulated luck is extremely strong.

However, more than a hundred thousand low-level monsters in the area provided more luck than he had obtained by unifying the three northeast countries and slaughtering more than half of the central and five Kanto countries. It was almost two or three times that of those lucks. It was extremely terrifying. .

So much luck has already made him feel overwhelmed.

There is no world here without him, and it is impossible to store luck in the world. Relying on Zhong Yu's personal body alone, after being far away from his own country, he has reached the limit of what he can bear.

If you continue to fight here, even if you get more luck, you won't be able to digest it, and you can only escape in vain.

So it's better to retreat, turn these luck into strength, and wait until the strength is further improved, and it's not too late to settle accounts with these gods.

What's more, what's more, this is Takamahara, the kingdom of God in the whole of Japan.

Just now, because he didn't know his strength well, among the active five demigods, he only sent one Susano to let this reckless man test his strength, while the others hid behind the scenes to install and observe, acting as orioles.

Now after such a long battle, they should have an understanding of their own strength. They are also in the sixth-order demigod with them, and have not yet ignited the fire. Although they are much stronger than ordinary sixth-order demigods, they are still not beyond what they can handle limit.

So it is very likely that these five demigods will partner up and deal with themselves together.

Even though his own strength is not weak now, there is no need to worry about his life against these five demigods, and he should be able to retreat completely.

But it will inevitably consume a lot of his strength, and maybe some of the luck he just got will dissipate, and there is no guarantee that he will not be injured.

Although most of the injuries he suffered from the torrent of chaos have been recuperated, there are still some root causes that are difficult to remove.

Zhong Yu needs more luck, it is best to make a breakthrough in strength, so as to completely repair the physical damage.

Now if he does it rashly, it is very likely to cause injuries, make him more injured, and waste more time to recover from his injuries, which is extremely worthless.

What's more, if these five people are really defeated, will it really be possible to safely take over the whole of Japan?

Above them, there are two supreme gods whose strength has reached the peak of demigods, and the divine fire has been ignited. They only need to condense their godheads to become real gods.

This kind of existence is not what the injured self can deal with.

If you have the support of the country, you can mobilize the strength of the entire country and condense the country's beliefs, and you won't be too afraid to deal with these gods.

But now Zhong Yu is separated from his own empire by countless space worlds, and his connection to his own small world is also faintly visible, extremely thin.

With such a long distance, the empire he built had little increase in Zhong Yu.

As for the places occupied by Japan, there are some beliefs in these gods in the legal system, and the rule is too short. Many people are not convinced of his rule, and it is difficult to gather enough national beliefs to fight against the gods.

So if he really confronts those two supreme gods, Zhong Yu will definitely fall into a disadvantage, although it is unlikely.

But it will definitely be completely like a bereaved dog, running around, and recovering from the injury is nowhere in sight.

"Susano, after the current battle, you and I have settled our grievances separately, and both sides have plotted against each other once, why bother to fight to the death."

Zhong Yu persuaded.

"At the point where you and I are, life is extremely long. It's not worth living and dying for these mere ants."

Zhong Yu didn't want to fight anymore, especially when he saw four golden lights in the distance, among which were flickering figures, exuding endless power. He Lan seemed like the remaining four demigods would also join the battlefield.

"Stop talking nonsense, do you think you can still escape now?"

Looking around, I saw that the number of people on my side increased, and the odds of winning increased. Seeing that Zhong Yu on the opposite side was already a little subdued and feeling scared, Susanoo's confidence was greatly increased, and he said without compromise.
